Reasoning-effort and context options run the same model with different settings. They are not separate models and have no separate publisher cards. Picker observations reflect one account on one date; plans, policies, and rollouts change what a user sees.

## Publisher document coverage

This folder uses [GPT-5 System Card](https://cdn.openai.com/gpt-5-system-card.pdf) (OpenAI, 2025-08-13). The GPT-5 System Card covers the GPT-5 family. It states that the API provides the thinking model, its mini version, and a nano version, and reports the mini model as gpt-5-thinking-mini.

Document revision used: SHA-256 `f9f9c72d08cba81dcbb189129119357c8c32eca4e0b16c813aca386aed6b0459` (PDF, 60 pages).
